examples.japanese: どうせ金なんてそのうちなくなるんだ
examples.body_text:
どうせ金なんてそのうちなくなるんだ 

After all (eventually) 
		money you now have will be gone.
examples.body_html:
どうせ金なんてそのうちなくなるんだ 
After all (eventually) money you now have will be gone.

examples.japanese: どうせ二人は枯すすき、花の咲かない枯ススキ
examples.body_text:
どうせ二人は枯すすき、花の咲かない枯ススキ 

After all 
		we two are nothing but withered grass: flowerless grass
examples.body_html:
どうせ二人は枯すすき、花の咲かない枯ススキ 
After all we two are nothing but withered grass: flowerless grass

examples.japanese: どうせ郵便局へ行くのなら、切手を買ってくださいませんか？
examples.body_text:
どうせ郵便局へ行くのなら、切手を買ってくださいませんか？ 

		Since you're going to the post-office 
		anyway 
		won't you please buy some stamps for me?
examples.body_html:
どうせ郵便局へ行くのなら、切手を買ってくださいませんか？ 
Since you're going to the post-office anyway won't you please buy some stamps for me?

examples.japanese: どうせ行かなければならないのなら早いほうがいいです。
examples.body_text:
どうせ行かなければならないのなら早いほうがいいです。 

		If you have to go 
		anyway 
		, then you might as well do it quickly.
examples.body_html:
どうせ行かなければならないのなら早いほうがいいです。 
If you have to go anyway , then you might as well do it quickly.

examples.japanese: あなたが手伝ってくれないことは分かっている。どうせあなたはそういう人だ。
examples.body_text:
あなたが手伝ってくれないことは分かっている。どうせあなたはそういう人だ。 

		I know you won't help me. That's the kind of guy you are, after all.
examples.body_html:
あなたが手伝ってくれないことは分かっている。どうせあなたはそういう人だ。 
I know you won't help me. That's the kind of guy you are, after all.

comments.text: どうせ is a word that characterizes the Japanese view of the transient and mutability of life. いろは歌 is a typical example.
comments.html: どうせ is a word that characterizes the Japanese view of the transient and mutability of life. いろは歌 is a typical example.

comments.text: The second example is a quote from a old Japanese pop song about a man and his wife whose life would end up as a river boat ferry man.
comments.html: The second example is a quote from a old Japanese pop song about a man and his wife whose life would end up as a river boat ferry man.

sections.text:
どうせ [どうせ] (douse)
    Meaning: after all; eventually; at best 
    Example: After all, there's nothing permanent.
    JLPT Level: 3
    Category: grammar
    Author: bamboo4
